newsitem.title: USA: COMPAQ CUTS PRICES OF SOME NOTEBOOK PCS.
newsitem.headline: COMPAQ CUTS PRICES OF SOME NOTEBOOK PCS.

text.p: Compaq Computer Corp on Monday said it cut prices in the United States on its Armada 1500 and Armada 4100 notebook personal computer models.

Compaq said the models include the following: the Armada 4100 11.3STN Pentium 100 MHz, 8MB RAM/810HD, was cut 17 percent to $999 from $1,199; Model 4110D, with MCDU, 4X CD, was reduced 25 percent to $1,198 from $1,599; the Armada 1500, Model 1530 was cut 14 percent to $2,499 from $2,899.

"The price/performance equation ratchets up another notch," said Jim Schraith, Compaq vice president and general manager for North America. "...We hope to attract an even broader audience, including those potential customers who are looking for their first notebooks."
